parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/StreamErrorAnalyticsTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.75 indicates structural near-duplication, the two methods — `streamErrorIncludesSessionDuration` (line 98) and `streamErrorAfterStallIncludesStallDuration` (line 124) — are distinct test scenarios: one asserts that a session duration is included in a stream-error analytics event, and the other asserts that a stall duration is included after a stall. Their structural similarity is a natural consequence of the arrange-act-assert test pattern, not accidental duplication. Merging or abstracting them would obscure the distinct behavioral intent each test encodes and couple unrelated failure modes.
